name: Philip (tetrarch)
title: Tetrarch of Iturea
summary: Philip was the son of Herod the Great and tetrarch over Iturea and Trachonitis. He built the city of Caesarea Philippi and ruled his territory gently during Jesus' time.

keyEvents.title: Tetrarch at the time of Jesus' ministry
keyEvents.description: Philip ruled as tetrarch over Iturea and Trachonitis when John the Baptist appeared.
